{{Quote|Here are the coordinates of an area we suspect the Dantari to have a heavy concentration of their people.|An Imperial colonel, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aIC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|an Imperial Colonel|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Kunga Stronghold''' was a fortified cave settled by the [[Kunga]] tribe on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="SWG:KS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] tasked a spacer with exploring the stronghold.<ref name="SWG:aIC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kunga Stronghold was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
